biography: I'm an Associate Director in Cost Management at Turner & Townsend, with experience in both the UK and US markets spanning Life Sciences, Education, Logistics, Data Centers, Healthcare and Tech clients. Working across that range of sectors has given me a broad commercial perspective, with each bringing its own delivery challenges, client expectations and risk profile. This variety is something I've actively sought out and built on throughout my career. My work covers the full project lifecycle, from early cost planning and estimating through procurement, contract administration and GMP Cost Plus delivery. I have particular depth in contractor challenge, pay application review and cost assurance, areas where commercial judgement is essential. BSc (Hons) Building Surveying - University of Central Lancashire
